scenes.title: Golfing with the Empress
scenes.summary: On a sunny golf course, a conglomerate Proprietor and the satellite President court a stubborn heiress nicknamed the Empress for their five-company space alliance while ordering Muranishi's commotion silenced.

scenes.title: A Comeback Press Conference
scenes.summary: Muranishi and Kuroki hold a exuberant press conference promising a comeback masterpiece that will surpass their biggest hit, and Kuroki thanks Muranishi for sharing their dream again.

scenes.title: Kawada's Search for Something New
scenes.summary: Abandoned by his former staff, Kawada confesses to a rival video Proprietor at a strip club that ordinary videos bore him completely, before running into Chu peddling adult novelties.

scenes.title: We Never Sign with an Ex-Con
scenes.summary: Muranishi and the bank Section Chief return to the satellite company with an official appointment, only for the company President to reject Muranishi's bid flatly because of his criminal record.

scenes.title: The Sign Comes Near Despair
scenes.summary: After a dejected Muranishi brushes off questions about his new script, the shy newcomer freezes at her first shoot and Kuroki gently tells her that the sign to take the first step arrives near despair.

scenes.title: Quarrel Before the Ambush
scenes.summary: Waiting at a restaurant for Furuya, Toshi angrily confronts the young hostess over her mother's debt trap and falls silent when asked if he can fix her life, right before Furuya arrives to toast a paroled gangster.

scenes.title: Gunfire and Back-Alley Escape
scenes.summary: Foreign gunmen ambush Furuya's celebration in a hail of bullets; a wounded Toshi flees down a back stairwell with the young hostess while police and Detective Takei converge outside.

scenes.title: Crashing the Mansion Dinner
scenes.summary: Muranishi crashes the satellite President's private wine dinner with the conglomerate heiress to avenge his humiliation, outrageous and intriguing the heiress even as security guards drag him away.

scenes.title: Waiting Outside and a Sudden Call
scenes.summary: Outside the mansion, Muranishi's assistant fumes that giant corporations cannot see how far ahead of his time Muranishi is, and a bruised Muranishi calmly answers a sudden phone call.

scenes.title: A Criminal Record Is Like a Medal
scenes.summary: Summoned to a banquet hall, Muranishi delights the heiress into backing the five-company space alliance, and the conglomerate Proprietor rewards him with a satellite channel over the satellite President's protests.

scenes.title: Clashing Over What the Market Wants
scenes.summary: On the day of her comeback shoot, Kuroki is dismayed by Muranishi's crude multi-actor script and lack of personal involvement, while Muranishi insists satellite is the company's lifeline.

scenes.title: Take Back What You Just Said
scenes.summary: When Muranishi shouts that their legendary hit was just an unrepeatable fluke of miracles, a heartbroken Kuroki walks off the set and the shy newcomer offers to step in as her replacement.
